{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Clinton-Gore Administration ended ethnic cleansing in Bosnia and Kosovo by the resolute use of military power and vigorous diplomacy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party first opposed the Administration's efforts to restore peace in the Balkans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party now tries to impede the Administration's efforts to rebuild Balkan societies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We look forward to the day when Serbia will be free from the grip of Slobodan Milosevic.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will work to make Serbia free from the grip of Slobodan Milosevic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America did right in the Balkans.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We must finish the job in the Balkans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recognizing the need of the modern Armenian state for security and economic growth, Al Gore and the Democratic Party are committed to continuing efforts to bring a permanent end to tensions between Armenia and Azerbaijan over Nagorno-Karabakh.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore and the Democratic Party are committed to the restoration of diplomatic, commercial, and economic ties between Armenia and her neighbors, including Turkey.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore helped bring about a special task force to intensify economic cooperation between the United States and Armenia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Remembering the historic suffering of the people of Armenia.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
